newsitem.title: USA: ITT Fluid expands into China.
newsitem.headline: ITT Fluid expands into China.

text.p: ITT Industries Inc unit ITT Fluid Technology Corp said on Tuesday it was expanding its submersible pump operations into China.
The company said it formed a new wholly-owned foreign enterprise called ITT Flygt (Shenyang) Pump Co Ltd which would manufacture and service submersible pumps in China.
The Flygt-brand pumps were particularly compatible with China's focus on creating centralized collection systems for industrial waste and wastewater, it said.
The new company is located in Shenyang and would have capacity to produce 15,000 of these pumps a year, it said.

In forming the unit, ITT said it converted its 75 percent stake in Shenyang ITT Flygt Jinbei Pump Co Ltd, a 1995 joint venture between ITT Flygt, a division of ITT Fluid, and Chinese automobile manufacturer FAW-Jinbei Auto Co Ltd.

The new wholly owned company is part of ITT Industries (China) Investment Co Ltd, a recently formed holding company that oversees ITT's business operations in China. ITT Fluid said its other units also actively market in Asia.
